architecture.front_end: 2x Conv2d(3x3, stride 2) + BatchNorm + ReLU; time downsample x4
architecture.features: log-mel 80 bins, win 400, hop 200 (12.5 ms), per-utterance CMVN

training.data: FLEURS ur_pk train split, 2108 of 2109 utterances (1 CTC-infeasible excluded)
training.optimizer: AdamW lr 1.5e-3, wd 0.01, 1-epoch linear warmup, cosine to 5%
training.note: Training stopped after epoch 17: dev CER had not improved since epoch 10 (plateau 0.5365-0.5672) while train loss kept falling. The run was interrupted once by environment process loss (after epoch 16) and resumed from the per-epoch checkpoint with no work lost. Earlier discarded attempts (a detached-launch death, an OOM kill at a larger batch budget, and a run with a learning-rate-schedule bug) are documented in REPORT.md.
